label: Dominance between two designs
subgoals: Compare the two designs objective by objective
Require no worse in every objective
Require strictly better in at least one objective

label: Finding the Pareto front
subgoals: Sort the designs by the first objective
Sweep and keep a design only if it beats the best second objective so far
Handle ties so that equal designs are not counted as dominated

label: More objectives, larger fronts
subgoals: Test domination across all objectives at once
Remove each design dominated by any other
Turn objectives into constraints when the front grows too large to use
